provider: NIKON IMAGE SPACE and Nikon Imaging Cloud

free_tier.stated: 2 GB free for anyone, 20 GB free with a registered Nikon product. SnapBridge offers 'free, unlimited automatic upload of 2-megapixel images'

retention.stated: The service terminates on 2026-10-15 and is replaced by Nikon Imaging Cloud with 5 GB

tooling: no public API. SnapBridge is the only ingest path
chaining: The only unlimited thing is a 2-megapixel downscaled JPEG, which is the ingest-re-encode trap in its purest form: the bytes that come back are not the bytes you sent.

limits.value: 2 GB or 20 GB account total, images only

identity_cost.detail: a Nikon ID, and 20 GB needs a registered product serial

reliability_note: Terminated on 2026-10-15, inside the research window, which is why the record carries the date and not a quota. The replacement offers 5 GB

evidence.proved: 'The NIKON IMAGE SPACE service will be terminated on October 15, 2026' '2GB of space just for signing up'
'誰でも2GB。ニコン製品をお持ちのお客様は20GBまで無料'
'free, unlimited automatic upload of 2-megapixel images', so the unlimited tier is downscaled
shutdown begins 2026-10-15 and the replacement offers 5 GB

binding_note: The service ended on 2026-10-15, so the retention clamp is complete. The 2 GB and 20 GB quotas were already under the filter and the downscaled unlimited tier returns different bytes, which is a failure in its own right.
notes: Recorded with its death date because the death is the finding. The SnapBridge unlimited tier is the corpus's clearest example of an unlimited claim that is true and worthless: 2-megapixel JPEGs are not the original image.

aliases: NIKON IMAGE SPACE / Nikon Imaging Cloud
